slides.eyebrow: SONGWRITING TRICKS YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE
slides.headline: HIT [[RECORD]] FIRST.
YOU WON'T [[REMEMBER]] IT.
slides.body: Every muso swears they'll remember that riff tomorrow. Nobody ever does. The good ones vanish fastest.

slides.headline: SO LEAVE IT [[RUNNING]].
slides.body: Voice memo on before you start playing. Not once it sounds good — before. Let it catch the mess.

slides.headline: THE [[MESS]] IS THE GOLD.
slides.body: Half your best ideas happen while you're warming up and not really trying. Only the tape notices.

slides.headline: "[[SATISFACTION]]" WAS A 3AM VOICE MEMO.
slides.body: Keith Richards woke up, played the riff into a bedside cassette and fell straight back asleep. The tape: a couple of minutes of riff, then the rest of it snoring.
